村.name: Village
村.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical> with some <radical>glue</radical>. Glue enough trees together and you've built a <kanji>village</kanji>.
村.reading: They find it by sonar, そん. 村 on its own is むら.

竹.name: Bamboo
竹.reading: A chick, ちく, hides in the bamboo. On its own bamboo is たけ.

林.name: Grove
林.meaning: Two <radical>tree</radical>s. A couple of trees make a <kanji>grove</kanji>.
林.reading: Hang a ring, りん, between them. On its own it's はやし.

森.name: Forest
森.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical> on top of a <radical>grove</radical>. Three trees: a whole <kanji>forest</kanji>.
森.reading: You bang your shin, しん, on a root. On its own it's もり.

玉.name: Jewel
玉.meaning: A <radical>king</radical> with a <radical>drop</radical>. The drop is the <kanji>jewel</kanji> in his crown, round as a ball.
玉.reading: たま: a tomato-sized jewel. 玉 is a ball; 十円玉 a 10-yen coin (だま). In compounds, ぎょく.

虫.name: Insect
虫.reading: It's using a chew toy, ちゅう. On its own a bug is むし.

糸.name: Thread
糸.reading: Spun from a sheep, し. On its own it's いと.

貝.name: Shellfish
貝.meaning: An <radical>eye</radical> on <radical>eight</radical> little legs. It's a <kanji>shellfish</kanji> peeking out.
貝.reading: かい: it lives under a kite. 貝 is shellfish.

算.name: Calculate
算.meaning: <radical>Bamboo</radical>, an <radical>eye</radical> and <radical>clasped hands</radical>. Hold the bamboo abacus and watch it closely to <kanji>calculate</kanji>.
算.reading: Under the sun, さん. 計算 is calculation; 予算 a budget.

泉.name: Spring
泉.meaning: <radical>White</radical> over <radical>water</radical>. White water bubbling up: a <kanji>spring</kanji>.
泉.reading: Throw a cent, せん, in. 温泉 is a hot spring.

線.name: Line
線.meaning: <radical>Thread</radical> from the <radical>spring</radical>. A thread of water: a <kanji>line</kanji>.
線.reading: One cent, せん, per line. 線 is a line; 新幹線 the bullet train.

門.name: Gate
門.reading: A monk, もん, guards it. 専門 is a speciality.

谷.name: Valley
谷.reading: Pop a cork, こく, and it echoes. On its own it's たに.

細.name: Thin
細.meaning: <radical>Thread</radical> next to a <radical>rice paddy</radical>. The paths between paddies are as <kanji>thin</kanji> as thread.
細.reading: Cut it with a scythe, さい. 細い is thin; 細かい detailed.

丸.name: Round
丸.meaning: <radical>Nine</radical> with a <radical>drop</radical>. Roll the drop around the nine and it becomes <kanji>round</kanji>.
丸.reading: まる: round as a marble. 丸い is round. In compounds, がん.

戸.name: Door
戸.meaning: The <radical>door</radical> radical: <kanji>door</kanji>, a single swing door.
戸.reading: A cobra, こ, slides under it. 戸 on its own is と; 江戸 Edo.

羽.name: Feather
羽.reading: An owl hoots "う", losing a feather. On its own it's はね; it counts birds as わ.

岩.name: Boulder
岩.reading: Shoot it with a gun, がん. It doesn't care. On its own it's いわ.

角.name: Corner
角.meaning: The <radical>horn</radical> radical. Horns are pointy, like a <kanji>corner</kanji>.
角.reading: A cackling witch, かく, waits round the corner. 角 is かど; 三角 a triangle.

池.name: Pond
池.meaning: <radical>Water</radical> with a <radical>scorpion</radical> in it. A small <kanji>pond</kanji>.
池.reading: A cheetah, ち, drinks from it. On its own it's いけ; 電池 a battery.

星.name: Star
星.reading: Sail by the stars, せい. On its own it's ほし.

寺.name: Temple
寺.reading: The monks drive a jeep, じ. On its own it's てら, or お寺.

弱.name: Weak
弱.meaning: Two <radical>bow</radical>s covered in <radical>ice</radical>. Frozen bows are <kanji>weak</kanji>.
弱.reading: Break the ice with a jackhammer, じゃく. 弱い is weak.

毛.name: Fur
毛.meaning: The <radical>fur</radical> radical: <kanji>fur</kanji>, a tuft of hair.
毛.reading: A lawn mower, もう, trims it. On its own it's け; 毛布 a blanket.

黄.name: Yellow
黄.meaning: A <radical>stand</radical> over a <radical>reason</radical> with <radical>eight</radical> legs. A market stand selling <kanji>yellow</kanji> lemons.
黄.reading: A koala, こう, buys them. 黄色 is yellow (き).

雲.name: Cloud
雲.meaning: <radical>Rain</radical> over <radical>two</radical> and something <radical>private</radical>. Where rain keeps its secret: a <kanji>cloud</kanji>.
雲.reading: A caveman grunts "<reading>うん</reading>" at it. On its own it's <ja>くも</ja>.

麦.name: Wheat
麦.meaning: <radical>Life</radical> growing through <radical>winter</radical>. <kanji>Wheat</kanji> is planted in autumn and survives the winter.
麦.reading: Carry it in a backpack, ばく. On its own it's むぎ.

区.name: Ward
区.meaning: Something <radical>slide</radical>s into a <radical>hiding</radical> box. The city is divided into boxes: each is a <kanji>ward</kanji>.
区.reading: A cuckoo, く, runs each one. 区役所 is a ward office.

県.name: Prefecture
県.meaning: An <radical>eye</radical> over something <radical>small</radical>. The governor keeps an eye on every small town in the <kanji>prefecture</kanji>.
県.reading: Ken, けん, is governor. 県 is a prefecture.

委.name: Committee
委.meaning: <radical>Grain</radical> over a <radical>woman</radical>. She's <kanji>entrust</kanji>ed with the harvest by the <kanji>committee</kanji>.
委.reading: The committee chair is an eel, い. 委員 is a committee member.

島.name: Island
島.meaning: A <radical>bird</radical> on a <radical>mountain</radical>. The only land out at sea: an <kanji>island</kanji>.
島.reading: A toad, とう, lives there too. On its own it's しま.

農.name: Farming
農.meaning: <radical>Music</radical> over a <radical>dragon</radical>. Farmers sing to the dragon for rain: <kanji>farming</kanji>.
農.reading: Write the harvest in your notebook, のう. 農業 is agriculture.

州.name: State
州.meaning: <radical>Drop</radical>s between the lines of a <radical>river</radical>. Islands in a river: each is a <kanji>state</kanji>.
州.reading: Wear a shoe, しゅう, to cross. 九州 is Kyushu.

階.name: Floor
階.meaning: A <radical>building</radical> for <radical>everyone</radical>. Everyone gets their own <kanji>floor</kanji>.
階.reading: Fly a kite, かい, off the top one. 二階 is the second floor; 階段 stairs.

橋.name: Bridge
橋.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical>, something <radical>big</radical>, a <radical>mouth</radical> and a <radical>helmet</radical>. A big tree across the river's mouth: a <kanji>bridge</kanji>.
橋.reading: Built in Kyoto, きょう. On its own it's はし.

干.name: Dry
干.meaning: The <radical>dry</radical> radical: <kanji>dry</kanji>. Laundry hanging on a pole.
干.reading: Hang it on a kangaroo, かん. 干す is to dry.

岸.name: Shore
岸.meaning: A <radical>mountain</radical> over a <radical>cliff</radical> over something <radical>dry</radical>. The dry land at the foot of the cliffs: the <kanji>shore</kanji>.
岸.reading: Pirates land with a gun, がん. 海岸 is the coast; 岸 きし.

央.name: Center
央.meaning: Someone <radical>big</radical> with a <radical>stick</radical> through a frame. They're dead <kanji>center</kanji>.
央.reading: They shout "ow!", おう. 中央 is the centre.

根.name: Root
根.reading: An ice cream cone, こん, stuck in the roots. 大根 is daikon; 根 is ね.

鉄.name: Iron
鉄.meaning: <radical>Gold</radical> you <radical>lose</radical>. Lose the gold and all that's left is <kanji>iron</kanji>.
鉄.reading: Pitch a tent, てつ, with iron pegs. 地下鉄 is the subway.

短.name: Short
短.meaning: An <radical>arrow</radical> and a <radical>bean</radical>. An arrow as long as a bean is very <kanji>short</kanji>.
短.reading: Fire it from a tank, たん. 短い is short.

油.name: Oil
油.meaning: <radical>Water</radical> with a <radical>reason</radical> to float on top. <kanji>Oil</kanji>.
油.reading: Polish a unicorn, ゆ, with it. 石油 is petroleum; 油 あぶら.

植.name: Plant
植.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical> you <radical>fix</radical> in the ground. <kanji>Plant</kanji> it.
植.reading: It gets a shock, しょく, from the cold. 植物 is a plant; 植える to plant.

倍.name: Double
倍.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> who <radical>stand</radical>s on a <radical>mouth</radical>. They look <kanji>double</kanji> their height.
倍.reading: They ride a bicycle, ばい, for two. 二倍 is double.

皮.name: Skin
皮.meaning: The <radical>skin</radical> radical: <kanji>skin</kanji>, hide being pulled off.
皮.reading: It peels off your heel, ひ. On its own it's かわ; 皮肉 sarcasm.

波.name: Wave
波.meaning: <radical>Water</radical> and <radical>skin</radical>. The skin of the sea: <kanji>wave</kanji>s.
波.reading: "Ha!" は, you laugh as one hits you. 波 is なみ; 電波 radio waves.

練.name: Practice
練.meaning: <radical>Thread</radical> from the <radical>east</radical>. You <kanji>practice</kanji> weaving it every day.
練.reading: Use a lens, れん, to check. 練習 is practice.

軽.name: Light
軽.meaning: A <radical>car</radical> on a <radical>stool</radical> over <radical>dirt</radical>. You can lift it onto a stool: it's <kanji>light</kanji>.
軽.reading: Light as a cake, けい. 軽い is light.

血.name: Blood
血.meaning: The <radical>blood</radical> radical: <kanji>blood</kanji>, a drop falling into a plate.
血.reading: Boil it in a kettle, けつ. (Please don't.) On its own it's ち.

皿.name: Plate
皿.reading: さら: pile salad on it. 皿 is a plate; お皿.

温.name: Warm
温.meaning: <radical>Water</radical>, the <radical>sun</radical> and a <radical>plate</radical>. Sun on a plate of water keeps it <kanji>warm</kanji>.
温.reading: Switch the heater on, おん. 温泉 is a hot spring; 温かい warm.

庫.name: Storehouse
庫.meaning: A <radical>car</radical> under a <radical>canopy</radical>. A <kanji>storehouse</kanji> for the car.
庫.reading: A cobra, こ, lives inside. 車庫 is a garage; 冷蔵庫 a fridge.

坂.name: Slope
坂.meaning: <radical>Dirt</radical> that's <radical>against</radical> you. You push uphill: a <kanji>slope</kanji>.
坂.reading: さか: the "soccer" ball rolls down it. 坂 is a slope; 大阪 (a different さか).

板.name: Board
板.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical> pushed <radical>against</radical> a saw. It comes out as a <kanji>board</kanji>.
板.reading: Carry it in your hand, はん. 黒板 is a blackboard (ばん); 板 いた.

章.name: Chapter
章.meaning: A <radical>sound</radical> over something <radical>early</radical>. The first sounds of the book: <kanji>chapter</kanji> one.
章.reading: Read it in a show, しょう. 文章 is writing; 第一章 chapter one.

秒.name: Second
秒.meaning: <radical>Grain</radical> and <radical>few</radical>. A few grains fall through the hourglass: one <kanji>second</kanji>.
秒.reading: A bee, びょう, buzzes each second. 一秒 is one second.

柱.name: Pillar
柱.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical> fit for a <radical>master</radical>. The master's house is held up by it: a <kanji>pillar</kanji>.
柱.reading: A dog's chew toy, ちゅう, is tied to it. 柱 is はしら.

祭.name: Festival
祭.meaning: The <radical>moon</radical> and a <radical>show</radical>. A moonlit show: a <kanji>festival</kanji>.
祭.reading: Swing a scythe, さい, in the parade. お祭り is a festival.

筆.name: Brush
筆.meaning: <radical>Bamboo</radical> over a <radical>brush</radical>. The handle is bamboo: a writing <kanji>brush</kanji>.
筆.reading: Write a hit song, ひつ, with it. 筆 is ふで; 鉛筆 a pencil (ぴつ).

童.name: Child
童.meaning: A <radical>stand</radical> over a <radical>village</radical>. The village kids stand in a row: <kanji>child</kanji>ren.
童.reading: Each gets a donut, どう. 童話 is a fairy tale; 児童 children.

緑.name: Green
緑.meaning: <radical>Thread</radical>, a <radical>broom</radical> and a <radical>splash</radical>. Dye the thread with a splash from the broom: <kanji>green</kanji>.
緑.reading: A rocket, りょく, painted green. 緑 is みどり.

荷.name: Luggage
荷.meaning: <radical>Grass</radical> over <radical>what</radical>. "What is all this?" It's your <kanji>luggage</kanji>.
荷.reading: It fills your car, か. 荷物 is luggage (に).

灰.name: Ash
灰.reading: It blows off your kite, かい. 灰 is はい; 灰色 grey.

炭.name: Charcoal
炭.meaning: A <radical>mountain</radical> over <radical>ash</radical>. Dig under the mountain and find <kanji>charcoal</kanji>.
炭.reading: Fill a tank, たん, with it. 炭 is すみ.

湖.name: Lake
湖.meaning: <radical>Water</radical>, something <radical>old</radical> and the <radical>moon</radical>. An old body of water under the moon: a <kanji>lake</kanji>.
湖.reading: A cobra, こ, swims across. 湖 is みずうみ.

湯.name: Hot Water
湯.meaning: <radical>Water</radical>, <radical>dawn</radical> and a <radical>banner</radical>. Hot springs raise a banner at dawn: <kanji>hot water</kanji>.
湯.reading: A toad, とう, soaks in it. お湯 is hot water (ゆ).

氷.name: Ice
氷.reading: A hyena, ひょう, skates on it. 氷 is こおり.

拾.name: Pick Up
拾.reading: Pick up a shoe, しゅう. 拾う is to pick up.

鼻.name: Nose
鼻.meaning: Your<radical>self</radical> over a <radical>rice paddy</radical> on <radical>clasped hands</radical>. Point at yourself: your <kanji>nose</kanji>.
鼻.reading: A bee, び, lands on it. 鼻 is はな.

協.name: Cooperate
協.meaning: A <radical>cross</radical> and three <radical>power</radical>s. Ten people all pulling together: <kanji>cooperate</kanji>.

改.name: Reform
改.meaning: <radical>Oneself</radical> and a <radical>whip</radical>. Whip yourself into shape: <kanji>reform</kanji>.
改.reading: Fly a kite, かい, to celebrate. 改札 is a ticket gate; 改める to revise.

府.name: Government
府.reading: Stamped with a hoof, ふ. 政府 is government; 大阪府 Osaka Prefecture.

軍.name: Army
軍.meaning: A <radical>car</radical> under a <radical>lid</radical>. A covered war chariot: the <kanji>army</kanji>.
軍.reading: Full of goons, ぐん. 軍隊 is the military.

各.name: Each
各.meaning: <radical>Winter</radical> legs over a <radical>mouth</radical>. <kanji>Each</kanji> person walks up and gets fed.
各.reading: A cackling witch, かく, serves them. 各地 is each place.

副.name: Vice
副.meaning: A <radical>mouth</radical> over a <radical>rice paddy</radical>, and a <radical>knife</radical>. The <kanji>vice</kanji>-president gets the second slice.
副.reading: Hang it on a hook, ふく. 副作用 is a side effect.

象.name: Elephant
象.meaning: A <radical>hook</radical> over a <radical>pig</radical>. A pig with a long hooked trunk: an <kanji>elephant</kanji>.
象.reading: It's in a show, しょう. 象 is ぞう; 印象 impression.

賞.name: Prize
賞.meaning: <radical>Esteem</radical> over a <radical>shell</radical>. Respect and money: a <kanji>prize</kanji>.
賞.reading: Awarded at a show, しょう. 賞 is a prize.

辺.name: Area
辺.reading: A hen, へん, runs around it. この辺 is around here.

低.name: Low
低.meaning: A <radical>person</radical>, a <radical>clan</radical> and the <radical>ground</radical>. The clan lies <kanji>low</kanji> on the ground.
低.reading: Under a table, てい. 低い is low.

課.name: Lesson
課.meaning: <radical>Say</radical> the <radical>fruit</radical> of your study. Recite the <kanji>lesson</kanji>.
課.reading: In the car, か. 第一課 is lesson one; 課長 section chief.

極.name: Extreme
極.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical>, <radical>two</radical>, a <radical>mouth</radical> and a <radical>stool</radical>. The tallest tree at the <kanji>extreme</kanji> end of the earth.
極.reading: A Kyoto song, きょく, plays there. 北極 is the North Pole; 積極的 positive.

量.name: Amount
量.meaning: <radical>Dawn</radical> over a <radical>village</radical>. Each dawn the village measures the <kanji>amount</kanji> of grain.
量.reading: At the rodeo, りょう. 量 is quantity.

型.name: Model
型.meaning: <radical>Punishment</radical> over <radical>dirt</radical>. Press the dirt into a <kanji>model</kanji> mould.
型.reading: Shaped like a cake, けい. 大型 is large-size (がた).

史.name: History
史.meaning: A <radical>mouth</radical> with a <radical>slide</radical> through it. The stories slide out of old mouths: <kanji>history</kanji>.
史.reading: Told by a sheep, し. 歴史 is history.

管.name: Pipe
管.meaning: <radical>Bamboo</radical> over an <radical>official</radical>. The official controls the bamboo <kanji>pipe</kanji>s.
管.reading: A kangaroo, かん, plays one. 管理 is management.

兵.name: Soldier
兵.meaning: A <radical>hill</radical> on <radical>eight</radical> legs. Soldiers marching over the hill: <kanji>soldier</kanji>.
兵.reading: Sleeping on hay bales, へい. 兵隊 is soldiers.

録.name: Record
録.meaning: <radical>Gold</radical>, a <radical>broom</radical> and a <radical>splash</radical>. Engrave it in gold: a permanent <kanji>record</kanji>.
録.reading: Carve it in a rock, ろく. 記録 is a record; 録音 a recording.

省.name: Ministry
省.meaning: <radical>Few</radical> over an <radical>eye</radical>. Close your eyes for a few moments to reflect. The <kanji>ministry</kanji> does too, supposedly.
省.reading: It sails, せい, slowly. 反省 is reflection; 外務省 the Foreign Ministry (しょう).

周.name: Lap
周.meaning: A <radical>helmet</radical> with <radical>good luck</radical> inside. Wear it for luck and run a <kanji>lap</kanji>.
周.reading: In your running shoes, しゅう. 周り is surroundings; 一周 one lap.

材.name: Material
材.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical> and <radical>talent</radical>. With talent, a tree becomes <kanji>material</kanji>.
材.reading: Carve a xylophone, ざい. 材料 is materials.

競.name: Compete
競.meaning: Two <radical>older brother</radical>s who <radical>stand</radical> side by side. They <kanji>compete</kanji> at everything.
競.reading: In a Kyoto race, きょう. 競争 is competition.

歴.name: History
歴.meaning: A <radical>grove</radical> under a <radical>cliff</radical>, and <radical>stop</radical>. Stop and look at the old trees: they've seen <kanji>history</kanji>.
歴.reading: An old wreck, れき, lies there. 歴史 is history.
